The ranking is unstable and errors are correlated; a softmax weighting may give a more robust spread across models.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a simple median over all models may provide robustness.
The series has unstable ranking (tau 0.212) and strong seasonality; a per‑pool weighted approach may diversify across less correlated models.
I want to test a per‑horizon weighted scheme that averages the top 3 models at each step; this may capture horizon‑varying strengths in this highly seasonal series.
The series has strong trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a trimmed mean over the full pool may reduce influence of outliers while keeping diverse models.
The series has strong seasonality and unstable ranking; a simple median over the stable pool may provide robustness.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9171. Series context: trend strength 0.9998 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.212); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.751.
